answer: Anchor each identity to two independent proofs, not a self-made cipher. First, the agent imports a signed reputation proof from a bank-verified account and a second from a two-year-old developer profile. Second, a verifier checks both signatures on-chain; any mismatch burns a 300 POA bond and locks the account 60 days. Third, proofs expire after 60 days, so an ember of stale reputation cannot stay lit forever. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 bank accounts at $120 each, $1,200,000, plus 20,000 aged profiles. Like a pulse checked at two wrists, one fake heartbeat cannot fool both hands.
